name: reading
description: A reading pane: Claude publishes documents, sections, issues and notes to read, you mark each read, acknowledged or to discuss with a comment, and the results go back as one message

issueCommand.title: Issue command
issueCommand.description: Command that prints an issue, with {number} standing for the issue number and {repo} for owner/repo. Empty runs fgj against the git remote's host: fgj --hostname <host> issue view {number} -R {repo}.
